sections.Profile:
The "Space Ship" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in December 1961, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Space, Original Theme, Sci-Fi
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Art: George Molentin
sections.Editions: - Space Ship: 800 made, released 1961-12-01, model number 256
